summary: E2E frontend testing of M4 DependencyDialog + TagBrowser Extract flows via Vite dev server with mocked window.opence. Exercised 7 of 9 mock scenarios (clean, scenario-bsp, external-data path via scenario-bsp, spheroid skipped as redundant with scenario-bsp warning path, bsp-only, large-list, deps-error, extract-error, slow-progress). All critical flows and testids from the spec are present and behave correctly. Zero console errors across every flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Dev-mock responses are canned per-scenario and ignore the actual selected indices (explicitly documented by main agent, acceptable). Fine for UI validation; a future improvement could at least echo the selected count/paths back into the fixture for a more realistic preview.
Virtualization confirmed: large-list (2200 tags) renders only ~24 DOM nodes inside dependency-tag-list and dialog opens in ~0.84s - good perf.
Everything flagged in the review request has a matching data-testid and the behavior matches the spec. No code changes required.

success_rate.backend: N/A (no HTTP backend; Electron main not runnable in this container)

verified_flows: Welcome screen renders with [data-testid=open-map-button] and MOCK DATA banner
Open Map populates Hierarchy tree (10 group checkboxes, tag-row-0..9), renders Map Overview panel
Extract button disabled with tooltip 'Select at least one tag first.' when nothing selected; enables when a tag checkbox is checked
Group checkbox [data-testid=tag-group-select-vehicle] toggles all tags under the group (Extract btn shows count '(1)')
Right-click on tag-row-4 opens tag-row-context-menu with tag-row-context-extract; clicking it opens the dependency-dialog
Ctrl+E keyboard shortcut opens the dependency-dialog

CLEAN scenario: summary='5 tag(s) extractable - 114.1 KB - 0 warning(s)', confirm button enabled, no understand-checkbox; Confirm -> result view with 'Extracted 5 tag(s) (178.0 KB).' and output path 'C:/Users/Dev/Documents/warthog.ocetags'; Open containing folder works (log shows '(mock) Would open containing folder')
SCENARIO-BSP: warning groups present (2 collapsible toggles), understand checkbox shown and gates Confirm (disabled -> enabled after check), Copy warnings button present

BSP-ONLY (allExcluded): confirm permanently disabled, dependency-confirm-disabled-reason shown with text 'Nothing here can be extracted (only scenario_structure_bsp tags, which aren't supported yet).', understand checkbox NOT rendered - exactly matches spec
DEPS-ERROR: dependency-dialog-error view shown when getDependencies throws
EXTRACT-ERROR: after confirming, dependency-extract-error view shown with Back button
SLOW-PROGRESS: Confirm -> dependency-progress view with dependency-cancel-button; Cancel button clickable (calls cancelExtraction)
LARGE-LIST (2200 tags): dialog opens in 0.84s and remains scrollable; only ~24 DOM items rendered (virtualization working)
Escape key closes dialog from both list and progress phases
Search input dependency-search-input accepts text without errors
Zero console errors / page errors across all flows
context_for_next_testing_agent: M4 Dependency/Extract UI feature is fully working in the browser-preview mock environment. Electron main-process (main.ts, map-worker.ts, worker-manager.ts, preload.ts, native save-as dialog, Ctrl+E global shortcut via Electron menu, Tools->Extract Tags menu item) cannot be exercised here (no Electron shell in headless container) - all other paths that trigger the same extractSelection handler (toolbar Extract button, context-menu Extract, Ctrl+E in-renderer listener) are verified. No regressions in prior iteration-4 fixes (Tools menu disabled parity still correct in welcome state). Use ?mock=<name> to pick scenarios: clean, scenario-bsp, external-data, spheroid, bsp-only, large-list, deps-error, extract-error, slow-progress.
